content.value: A major regional industry injects an extra \$20,00,000 into a regional economy through (05) its expansion program, it will generate an extra income. If \$2,00,000 of this extra income is lost to the government via taxes, \$8,00,000 is saved and \$5,00,000 is spent on goods and services imported into the region.
